messages:
Maria P (partnerships): Quick follow-up from today's sync. Ready to run the partner board sweep. Scope: compare perf/W, sustained throughput, and kernel tuning impact across two model builds. Sam, can you confirm what sensors and run window you can support? :satellite:
Sam H (partner-hw): We can stream board power via PMBus, host CPU temps, and kernel debug traces. Wed 12:00-16:00 UTC is free. We have 13B_int8 (SDK v2.1), 13B_int4 (quant), and 7B_fp16 (v1.9). Which should we prioritize?
Maria P (partnerships): Primary: 13B_int8 for perf/W. Baseline: 7B_fp16. Keep 13B_int4 as an extra check. Metrics: average watts (board), tokens/sec, p99 latency, cycles/token. Perf/W = tokens/sec / avg_watts. We'll push prompt set and harness.
Dan L (perf-eng): Kernel knob matrix to try: attn_opt=true/false, kv_cache_prefetch=true/false, prefetch_pages in [2,4]. Power caps: 250W and 200W. Minimal runbook that infra can adopt below:
```yaml
run_name: partner-board-sweep-2026
models:
  - name: 13B_int8
    seq_len: 2048
    profiles: [throughput, perf-w]
  - name: 7B_fp16
    seq_len: 2048
    profiles: [baseline]
kernel_flags:
  attn_opt: [true, false]
  kv_cache_prefetch: [true, false]
  prefetch_pages: [2, 4]
power_caps: [250, 200]
batch_sizes: [1, 8, 32, 64]
threads: [1, 2, 4]
logging_namespace: "hw.partner.sweep"
results_bucket: "/mnt/bench-results/partner-sweep-1769998800"
```
Sam H (partner-hw): We'll map sensors to hw.partner.sweep.board_power, hw.partner.sweep.cpu_temp, kernel.trace.attn. Voltage control is vendor-limited; we'll enforce powercap via vendor agent + IPMI. I'll drop mapping JSON and vendor notes in the run dir. Can pull prompt set during run.
benchbot: scheduled by Sam H for 1769998810 1-06-2026T12:05Z start. Artifacts to results_bucket. :robot_face:
Kevin M (field-eng): Suggest adding an auto-fallback: if throughput falls >15% compared to baseline across two consecutive windows, set attn_opt=false and rerun mid batch. Prevents long demos stalling. Also capture dmesg and oops logs.
Maria P (partnerships): Good idea. Actions: Sam -> sensor mapping + vendor daemon notes, Dan -> full runbook + git commit IDs for model builds, Kevin -> add fallback policy into orchestration. I'll assemble the joint marketplace PR after we verify runs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
